_meta.instructions: Every entry is a PLACEHOLDER marked VERIFY. Before any public use, a registered pharmacist must check every number, contraindication and warning against the official label of the exact product you dispense (e.g., DailyMed SPL, BNF monograph, or the DRAP-approved label), then fill in 'source', 'verified_by', 'verified_date' and set 'status' to 'VERIFIED'.

paracetamol.administration: Swallow with water, with or without food.
interactions: Many cold/flu, sinus and 'extra' pain products also contain paracetamol - count them in the 24-hour total.
Warfarin: regular paracetamol use can raise INR - ask a pharmacist.
warnings: Do not take with any other product that contains paracetamol.
Taking too much can cause serious liver damage even if you feel well. If you have taken more than the maximum, get medical help immediately.
Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine.
paracetamol.source: VERIFY against the official product label (DailyMed / BNF / DRAP-approved label).

ibuprofen.administration: Take with or just after food, with a full glass of water.
interactions: Do not combine with other NSAIDs (aspirin, diclofenac, naproxen, mefenamic acid).
Increases bleeding risk with blood thinners, antiplatelets, SSRIs/SNRIs and steroids.
warnings: Stop and get medical help if you notice black stools, vomiting blood or severe stomach pain.
Do not take with other anti-inflammatory painkillers.
ibuprofen.source: VERIFY against the official product label (DailyMed / BNF / DRAP-approved label).

cetirizine.administration: Swallow with water, with or without food.
interactions: Alcohol and other sedating medicines can increase drowsiness.
warnings: May cause drowsiness - do not drive or operate machinery if affected.
cetirizine.source: VERIFY against the official product label (DailyMed / BNF / DRAP-approved label).

loperamide.interval_text: first dose 4 mg, then 2 mg after each loose stool
loperamide.administration: Swallow with water. Drinking fluids / oral rehydration salts (ORS) is the most important treatment.
interactions: Never take more than the label maximum - high doses can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems.
warnings: Drink plenty of fluids or ORS to prevent dehydration.
Stop and see a doctor if diarrhoea lasts more than 48 hours, or if blood, fever or a swollen tummy appears.
loperamide.source: VERIFY against the official product label (DailyMed / BNF / DRAP-approved label).

calcium_carbonate.interval_text: when symptoms occur (at least 1 hour apart)
interactions: Can reduce absorption of other medicines (e.g., some antibiotics, iron, thyroid tablets) - take them at least 2 hours apart.
warnings: Take other medicines at least 2 hours apart from this antacid.
See a doctor if you need an antacid for more than 14 days.
